payload.body: Read-only post-timeout artifact evidence: `coverage/.tmp` contains 789 V8 `coverage-*.json` chunks totaling ~121 MiB; `coverage-0.json` mtime 20:22:22 local, `coverage-788.json` mtime 20:27:02 local, at the outer 300s cutoff. The successful noncoverage diagnostic also counted 789 unit test files and took 272.29s for that phase. This is consistent with broad test execution continuing until the deadline and little/no reporting margin; chunk numbering alone does NOT prove every test passed or explain the historical concurrent-send failure. No coverage threshold/result was emitted, so gate stays failed. Host reports 16 available CPUs; no config/timeout change, test rerun or other-agent process action.
